tasks.title: Schema migration: device_deadman_config in sqlite + mariadb + Store methods
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/004-dead-man-switch-heartbeat/{requirements.md, design.md, contracts/schemas/deadman-config.json}. SECOND: add device_deadman_config table per REQ-312 in BOTH internal/store/sqlite/ AND internal/store/mariadb/mariadb.go (Constitution Article XII). Columns: device_imei TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, timeout_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3600, last_seen_at INTEGER, triggered_at INTEGER, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL. Add Store interface methods: GetDeadmanConfig(ctx, tenantID, imei) + UpsertDeadmanConfig(ctx, tenantID, imei, enabled, timeoutSeconds) + TouchLastSeen(ctx, tenantID, imei, ts) + SetTriggeredAt(ctx, tenantID, imei, ts) + ClearTriggeredAt(ctx, tenantID, imei) + ListDeadmanEnabled(ctx). All tenant-scoped per Constitution Article IV.

tasks.title: Augment deadman.Monitor with DB-backed tick + Prometheus + escalation/audit/MQTT emit
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/004-dead-man-switch-heartbeat/{requirements.md, design.md, contracts/asyncapi.yaml, contracts/schemas/deadman-event.json}. SECOND: extend internal/deadman/ so Monitor (REQ-311) reads from device_deadman_config via the Store interface — no in-memory map; (REQ-303) on tick, for any (enabled=1 AND triggered_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at + timeout_seconds < now()) row, invoke escalation.Engine.Trigger; (REQ-304) write audit_log entry deadman.triggered; (REQ-305) publish to meshsat/{imei}/deadman/triggered via bus.MessageBus; (REQ-314) SetTriggeredAt to prevent re-fire; (REQ-316) increment hub_deadman_triggered_total. CheckIn(imei) (REQ-315) also calls ClearTriggeredAt when triggered_at was non-null + writes audit deadman.recovered + (REQ-317) increments hub_deadman_recovered_total. (REQ-318) tick interval defaults to 30 seconds, configurable via constructor.

tasks.title: Wire CheckIn into RockBLOCK + Cloudloop + position subscriber
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/004-dead-man-switch-heartbeat/{requirements.md, design.md}. SECOND: edit (REQ-300) internal/rockblock/handler.go and (REQ-301) internal/cloudloop/webhook.go — after a MO message is decoded SUCCESSFULLY (NOT in error/malformed paths), call h.deadmanMonitor.CheckIn(imei). The handlers already have SetDeadman() setters — main.go just needs to wire the same monitor instance to both (mirror the rockblock pattern). (REQ-302) Also wire CheckIn into the position subscriber's onPositionUpdate handler (locate via grep for SetDeadman or position.Subscriber). Both check-ins MUST happen AFTER any conditional reassembly (spec 002) and decryption (spec 003) — so a fragmented or encrypted message that successfully resolves counts as one CheckIn, not multiple. Edit cmd/meshsat-hub/main.go to call SetDeadman on the cloudloop handler and on the position subscriber if not already wired.

tasks.title: REST API: GET + POST /api/devices/{imei}/deadman with tenant filter + bounds check
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/004-dead-man-switch-heartbeat/{requirements.md, contracts/openapi.yaml, contracts/schemas/deadman-config.json, acceptance/deadman-heartbeat.feature}. SECOND: implement internal/api/deadman.go exposing GET + POST per contracts/openapi.yaml. (REQ-306) GET returns the row + state from device_deadman_config. (REQ-307) POST uses httpjson.ReadJSON to parse {enabled, timeout_seconds}. (REQ-308) reject timeout_seconds < 60 with 400. (REQ-309) reject timeout_seconds > 86400 with 400. (REQ-310) tenant filter on every call; cross-tenant returns 403. Add @Summary/@Tags/@Router Swagger annotations. Tests cover happy path + bounds + cross-tenant + 404-on-unknown-device.
